      • readFile

        public boolean readFile(Identifier id)
        Responsible for reading in the impact region system file pointed
        to by the Identifier parameter. Runs through the list of Impact
        in the system and tells them where in the file to read there data
        from.

      • writeFile

        public boolean writeFile(Identifier id)
        Responsible for writing the System data file pointed to by the Identifier parameter. Runs through the list of Impact Regions in the system and passes them the BufferedWriter from the Identifier. Each impact region will write out his own data.
        Overrides:
        writeFile in class Manager
